items:
"Salty Life" - Back by popular demand, you'll love this newly updated coastal cottage home in the wonderful 30A-area neighborhood of Cypress Breeze!  The home features a huge community pool, golf cart, and beautiful upper/lower southern-cottage porches! Neighborhood is 1/2 mile to stunning emerald coast beaches, shopping, and dining! Great biking and hiking trails - kid friendly neighborhood!

Highlights:
- Huge Neighborhood Pool
- Golf Cart
- Bikes
- Quiet Street
- Short ride to beach, shopping, dining and more!
- Beautiful beach decor

Enjoy the neighborhood's plentiful coastal breezes, and wave hello to neighbors and friends making their way to the beach and pool.  The home is tastefully decorated and features a large open plan kitchen-living-dining area.

The living room area features seating for the whole family, with a large flat screen TV offering a great place for entertaining and relaxing.  The dining area provides seating for eight people, with three more stools at the kitchen breakfast bar.

The kitchen is well-equipped to prepare family meals, and features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and ample storage.

The master suite features a King bedroom, private bathroom with walk in shower, private balcony, and walk in closet!

The guest bedroom offers a queen bedroom, with coastal finishes, plenty of closet space. 

The bunk room has  five twin beds, arranged in two bunks, plus a trundle.

The guest bathroom is nicely sized, and is just a couple steps from both the guest bedroom and bunk room.  You'll also find a half bathroom conveniently located on the first floor.

The beach is just a short drive or moderate walk away from your front steps. Exactly one mile door-to-door, you'll find the Gulf Place Beach access with plentiful parking, rest rooms and lifeguards on duty in peak season.

If you're looking for a place with a fun pool, you cannot beat Cypress Breeze! Walk or bike to the amazing neighborhood pool - at about 13,000 square feet, with multiple waterfalls and grottos, it's one of the largest community pools in all of Northwest Florida!

You'll also find fun shopping and dining at Gulf Place - just check out the location guide for information! Great seafood, live music, ice cream shops, pizza, a beer garden, and more! All just an easy golf cart or bike ride away at Gulf Place!

Other fun features of this beach cottage include a washer/dryer, WiFi, and a private grilling patio in the back yard, with a gas grill! The quiet neighborhood streets have very little traffic.

Plan your next beach vacation at Salty Life, in the beautiful Cypress Breeze community of 30A - you'll be happy you did!

*We always try to keep some beach items (chairs, umbrella, toys, floaties) at the property for your use. While these are not guaranteed, there’s usually a good stock of items available. We do not provide beach towels. Please plan on bringing some with you, or purchase locally (inexpensive ones available at nearby stores).

*You must be at least 25 years of age to book this home. College-age spring break groups are not permitted, regardless of chaperone.

*RVs, boats, and/or trailers of any kind are not permitted in the neighborhood. Storage facilities do exist in the area, but space is extremely limited - be sure to plan ahead, as storage is not available or permitted on property.

*The Cypress Breeze neighborhood does not allow street parking. All vehicles must fit within the perimeter of the driveway and cannot overhang into the street. Overflow storage options may be available locally, but are not guaranteed - be sure to plan ahead, as overflow storage is not available or permitted on property.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and by the sea. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Sirens at the Beach are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
